summary: Positions the menu cursor on wrapped text. Reads the source text pointer (double-indirect this+0xE0) with a default fallback string, measures the current substring length, walks wrapped items via MenuCursorNavigationHelper to find the line containing the cursor, temporarily NUL-terminates the text at the cursor index to measure the sub-run with TextRenderToSurface, restores the character, applies a signed cursor advance clamped at zero, then advances through further wrapped items and renders the active item with MenuItemRenderHelper, storing the final index back to this+0xE4.

local_names.v8: next wrap position returned by MenuCursorNavigationHelper
local_names.v17: measured sub-run width passed to MenuItemRenderHelper
local_names.result: final cursor index stored to this+0xE4

operations.description: Read source text pointer through this+0xE0 (double-indirect); load the string, substituting the global default byte_5EA438 when the pointer is null
Measure the source string length v5 = strlen(text) + 1
First navigation loop: call MenuCursorNavigationHelper(this, v6) to locate the next wrap boundary, updating v6 to the returned index on each iteration
Break the navigation loop when no further wrapping (v6 == v8), when the cursor index (this+0xE4) is before the candidate, or at end-of-string where the last character is not the 0xFF delimiter
Set up the resource path: read the associated object via this+0xC8, take its char* at +0x40 (fallback byte_5EA438 if null) and pass it to sub_498560 for directory-path processing
Temporarily overwrite the text byte at the cursor index this+0xE4 with a NUL, measure the sub-run v4[v6] via TextRenderToSurface, then restore the original character
Compute the target cursor advance v13 = a2 + i and clamp it to zero when negative
If the clamped target v13 falls below the current index i, reset both i and v6 to zero and re-run MenuCursorNavigationHelper(this, 0)
Second loop: continue advancing v6 via MenuCursorNavigationHelper while the text at the returned index is non-empty, until i reaches the clamped target v13
Render the active menu item with MenuItemRenderHelper(this, measured_width, v6, result)
Store the final cursor position result to this+0xE4
Identified as the Menu_Cursor_Positioning ABI entry; menu-cursor positioning entry point

clean_pseudocode: if (pos == next || cursor >= next || (len - 1 == next && text[next - 1] != 0xFF)) break;
unresolved: The 0xFF byte used as a wrap delimiter is implied by the end-of-string guard; its exact encoding is not established.
Semantics of a2 (relative cursor delta) and the meaning of the count returned by MenuCursorNavigationHelper are inferred from usage only.
The associated object at this+0xC8 and its +0x40 resource-path string are not identified to a concrete class.
